The lawless territory of Montana is up for grabs, so William Clark and Marcus Daly fight to control power over the state and to mine millions in copper ore.
With 300 inventions, Nikola Tesla's work still dominates the world today. Interviews with experts reveal the fascinating life of the great inventor.
A witness claims to have discovered a long-lost ship. Experts launch an investigation to try and positively identify the missing vessel.
Richard's new state-of-the-art workshop is finally open but with nearly a quarter of a million out of his pocket, the business has got to start paying for itself.
The team test two electric vans, the Ford E-Transit and the Fiat e-Ducato, which both claim to top 150 miles between recharges, but it remains to be seen if they live up to the billing.
Trying out some larger vehicles, the team test a plug-in Hybrid VW T7 Transporter and match it up against a 7-seat PHEV SUV costing the same amount of money, the Hyundai Santa Fe.
JDV and Sid tackle some challenging terrain in a Land Rover P400E Defender. Vicki tries out the new MG EV4 and in Italy, Grace drives Ferrari's first V6, the 296 GTS hybrid.
Lockheed were tasked with creating a plane invisible to Russian radar, capable of reaching an altitude of 80,000 ft and speeds of Mach 3.2.
Emerging as a rival to Boeing's 247, the rigorously tested twin-engine DC-3 would eventually radicalise the aviation industry in 1934.
This double-decked monster was designed to carry 800 passengers and revolutionise the highways of the sky, so why did it take 17 years to lift off?

Henry and Sam are rummaging again. They meet Phil in sunny Buckinghamshire, where they find stationary engines, traction engines and vintage petrol cans, but is there anything for the boys to restore and flog?

Henry and his ace mechanic mate Sam Lovegrove are in Surrey where they find Pontiac ambulances, mysterious automotive sculptures, and strangely well-preserved motorbikes. Later, in Cornwall, they meet a collector whose cottage is like a transport museum, chock-full with memorabilia, penny farthings and lights of all description.

Bike guru Henry Cole and ace mechanic Sam Lovegrove are off to Cornwall. They meet a collector whose cottage is like a transport museum, chock-full with memorabilia, penny farthings and lights of all description.

The boys are off to the West Country and Oxfordshire, in search of vintage treasure to buy, restore and flog. Their discoveries include rare motoring memorabilia, 1970s kitsch and a fabulous collection of stationary engines.
In Barcelona, Mike and Elvis try to restore a SEAT 600, but an unexpected breakdown and some nasty bills put the boys' profit margin in peril.
Mike and Elvis travel to Turkey in search of one of the rarest cars they've ever bought, the Anadol STC16, but the one they find needs major work.
Mike and Elvis try to give a rare Škoda 110R a rally inspired makeover, but they soon discover it's a bigger and more expensive job than they thought.

Mike and Elvis travel to Turin and set about trying to rescue a rundown Fiat Barchetta. But when parts prove almost impossible to find, it looks like they may have to say arrivederci to their Italian sports car dream.

Having wanted to buy a Ford Cortina for 20 years, Mike finally finds a rust-free Mk2 in Malta. Unfortunately, the rest of the car is a complete shambles so it's down to Elvis and some plucky Maltese mechanics to try and rescue Mike's Cortina dream.
In Devon, presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove are on a mission to buy automobilia for a client's man cave. The guys uncover a 1937 petrol pump and a pricey tyre inflator.

This time, the duo fondly recall Rodney's rusty lair packed full of signs, petrol pumps and vintage British cars. Rodney found it hard to part with some of the items the deal-searching duo wanted, but they eventually came away with even more.
Presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove rescue interesting items from a scrapyard in Devon. The guys find some classic vehicles, including a neglected Jaguar Mark 1.
Presenter Henry Cole and motorcycle restorer Sam Lovegrove visit an incredible collection of Ford vehicles in Worcestershire. But the guys have their sights set on a 1960s Austin A40 Farina.
Mike ends up having a tip from an unusual source, from his electrician. He's selling a classic Ford Escort XR3i that he's owned for decades, but there are some issues with the roof.
Mike lands a desirable three-door Mk1 for £4500 in an internet auction. Will Edd's customisations and improvements bring a new lease of life to this much-loved 70s classic?
Mike Brewer makes a return to the United Kingdom with Marc Elvis Priestley and find iconic cars to revive them before selling.

Mike buys a 1995 Ford Escort RS Cosworth, a rare vehicle originally designed to qualify as a car for the World Rally Championship. Ant attempts to bring back the 227 hp engine's famous 'fizz' and adds a special detail.
Mike is after a Ford Sierra Cosworth, which looks like a family vehicle and runs like a race car, but with only £5,000 to spend, is his plan about to stall?
In an attempt to win work, Richard Hammond and the team decide to enter one of their cars into the UK's most prestigious classic car show contest, known as the 'Concours of Elegance'.

Ein Team von Weltklasse-Show-Wrestlern bietet den Fans zum ersten Mal seit 20 Jahren ein neues Wrestling-Erlebnis. Mit von der Partie sind Cody und Brandi Rhodes, Kenny Omega, Henker Adam Page, Chris Jericho und Jon Moxley.

Tony Sallis und sein Team haben bei einer Hausdurchsuchung mehrere mutmaßliche Straftäter aus dem Drogenmilieu im Visier. Die Verdächtigen sind wahrscheinlich bewaffnet, deshalb müssen die Gesetzeshüter sehr vorsichtig vorgehen.
Tanya Watkins und Harrison Beverley fahren mit ihrem zivilen Dienstwagen in Northamptonshire zur M1. Dort haben Überwachungskameras das Kennzeichen einer aktenkundigen Alkoholsünderin erfasst.

In einer Mainzer Einkaufsstraße tritt ein Gas aus und es herrscht Explosionsgefahr. Als die Einsatzkräfte die Ursache ausfindig machen, staunen sie nicht schlecht, denn es handelt sich nicht einfach um ein simples Gasleck.

In Dresden steckt ein kleines Kind zwischen zwei Holzbalken fest und braucht dringend die Hilfe der Feuerwehr. Um den Dreijährigen aus seiner misslichen Lage zu befreien, ist diesmal ein wahres Improvisationstalent gefragt.

Im Hafen von Barcelona kontrollieren die Zöllner Lkw-Anhänger, die mit der Fähre nach Tanger übersetzen. Es dauert nicht lange, bis die Beamten einen manipulierten Sattelauflieger entdecken. Außerdem gerät ein Fluggast aus Vancouver in Erklärungsnot.

Ein Spezialauftrag führt Thorsten Eckert in dieser Folge nach Frankfurt am Main. Der Asphalt Cowboy soll dort im Stadtwald Baumstämme abholen. Aber dann streikt am Lastkraftwagen plötzlich die Lenkung und ohne diese Maschine ist er aufgeschmissen.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Josh hilft, den reichsten verlorenen Schatz Amerikas zu bergen. Mit modernster Technologie und einer Flotte von Booten taucht das Team in der Karibik, um Münzen und Juwelen der legendären spanischen Galeone Maravillas an die Oberfläche zu bringen.

Bei extremer Hitze begeben sich Adam, Heather und Sam auf einen 15 Kilometer langen Marsch zu einem großen Fluss. Lindsay, Terra und Nathan kämpfen sich währenddessen durch ein von Schlangen besiedeltes Grasfeld zu einem Bach vor.
Die Küste von Zululand am Indischen Ozean ist der Schauplatz für den Showdown der Survival-Challenge.

Ed kämpft sich durch die Region Kimberley im Nordwesten Australiens. In dieser Gegend wimmelt es nur vor Giftschlangen und Riesenkrokodilen. Die Hitze dort ist extrem. Ed versucht, sich vor der Sonne zu schützen. Zudem findet er Austern als Nahrung.

Im Okavangodelta lauern unzählige Gefahren. Die Region im Nordwesten Botswanas ist mit über 20 000 Quadratkilometern eines der größten Feuchtgebiete Afrikas. Dort leben viele Raubtiere, wie zum Beispiel Leoparden, Hyänen und Wildhunde. Außerdem hat Ed Stafford dort mit der stacheligen Vegetation zu kämpfen. Die Dornen machen dem Briten auf dem schwarzen Kontinent so sehr zu schaffen, dass er sich Schuhe aus Palmwedeln bastelt.
Team Salvage schließt sich mit dem Hafenmeister zusammen, um die Wasserstraße freizumachen.

Luke Purdy und seine Crew nehmen im nördlichen Gebiet eine 14 Meter lange Jacht an den Haken. Der Auftrag bringt den Abschlepp-Profis 25 000 Dollar ein. Aber dieses Geld muss sich die Truppe in Down Under hart erarbeiten.

Die Grenzpolizei überprüft in der schwedischen Hauptstadt drei Personen ohne Gepäck, denn der Stockholmer Flughafen ist ein Sicherheitsbereich. Dort darf man sich nur aus einem berechtigten Grund aufhalten.

Am Stockholmer Flughafen ist eine Maschine aus Istanbul gelandet. An Bord befindet sich eine gesuchte Person. Der Passagier hat gegen Bewährungsauflagen verstoßen. Er wurde wegen Drogendelikten verurteilt.

Rick Ness hat eine Million Dollar investiert, um auf dem Walhalla-Abschnitt bis zum Gold vorzudringen. Aber nach mehr als vier Wochen Arbeit stößt sein Team stattdessen auf eine siebeneinhalb Meter dicke Lehmschicht. Wurde zu hoch gepokert?

Parker Schnabel versucht, verlorene Zeit wettzumachen. Der Minenboss kauft für eine Million Dollar eine neue Waschanlage. Die Golden Goose verfügt über längere Waschrinnen und ein modifiziertes Siebdeck, was einen höheren Durchsatz ermöglicht. Damit kann sein Team am Dominion River schneller und effizienter arbeiten. Doch zunächst müssen die Goldgräber das 40-Tonnen-schwere Monstrum einsatzbereit machen. Auch Tony Beets stürzt sich in Kosten.

Andreas, Tobi und Andrew suchen in Australien nach einem Edelmetallvorkommen. Doch dann bricht wegen der Trockenheit ein Feuer aus. Dieses darf sich nicht ausbreiten, da ein Flächenbrand die umliegenden Farmen und die Wildtiere bedrohen würde.

Die Macherey haben in Australien hart gearbeitet. Es naht in Down Under die Stunde der Wahrheit. Welche Empfehlung spricht Andreas im Northern Territory aus? Wird sich die Schatzsuche dort auszahlen? Mark vertraut auf Andreas' Einschätzung.

Im fiktiven Derry lauert in den Abwasserkanälen etwas Uraltes und Böses. Es nährt sich von den Ängsten der Kinder. Haben Ereignisse in seiner Heimatstadt den Schriftsteller Stephen King zu seinem Bestsellerroman "Es" inspiriert? Bangor wurde 1769 am Penobscot River im US-Bundesstaat Maine gegründet. Mitte des 19. Jahrhunderts zog die "Holzhauptstadt der Welt" auch das Laster an: Steckt in Stephen Kings Horrorgeschichten vielleicht ein Fünkchen Wahrheit?
When Richard was shot in the face he underwent a face transplant, but now has complications. Meanwhile, in a Peruvian village, boys and men are going blind.
American toddler Cora was born with a condition causing her hands to swell up. In Brazil, Judite was born with deformed legs and spine and walks on all fours.
Wayne has a trinity of classic Italian sports cars to auction in Florida, including a 1971 Ferrari Daytona Spyder. Will he make the 1.5 to 2 million dollar valuation?
Wayne is auctioning off a 1949 Mercury Woodie wagon and a rare 1961 Austin-Healey 3000 Mk I BN7 for a client. Will he be successful at the sale?
Wayne tracks down a Ferrari 275 GTB4 in Boston. After two tests and a few repairs the car is ready for resale. Meanwhile, in California Wayne takes a spin in an original 275.
When the magnetos in Wayne's Bentley break, he knows the only person for the job is mechanic Laurence Anderson. Laurence insists he visits his shop in California.
The 1967 Ferrari GTB four cam goes under the hammer, but will they achieve the price they are looking for? Plus, Wayne is delighted with his new 1958 Porsche speedster GS/GT.
Wayne visits a Porsche meet up at the European Auto Salvage Yard. From there he goes to a Berkeley car event where he's in car heaven with hand built hot rods.
A semi hauler comes in for a makeover, and since KevDogg is the resident truck expert, he takes centre stage on the design and oversees the build.

A 1969 Camaro comes in, and when Dave and team get a closer look, they determine with the owner that it requires a full re-build. Since the team will be starting from scratch, the client decides to go all-out on the chassis, engine and details.
The Camaro build continues, but hits a roadblock when it comes to getting the engine dialled in. Plus, Dave then has some second thoughts about the colour combination.
After years of planning, Dave celebrates the opening of his passion project, the Kindig Academy. The team then decide to throw a car show and have a friendly competition.
Having fallen in love with an old '78 Chevy K20 as a teenager, a farm girl knew she had to get it. But time and storage have taken their toll.
A rare '70 'Cuda convertible has been sitting for over 10 years. The team help its cancer-surviving owner get this Mopar monster back on the road.

Jeremy Wade reveals details of a high-speed chase between a narco sub and the US Coast Guard; with the help of declassified files and cutting-edge military technology, experts investigate if they've found Pablo Escobar's lost treasure.
Jeremy Wade explores how fresh insights into ancient boat building techniques shed new light on the truth behind the biblical story of Noah's Flood.

The team investigate recent encounters with a monstrous apex predator in the wilderness of British Columbia. They use never-before-seen clues from Ivan Sanderson's lost archive to uncover new evidence that may finally distinguish fact from fiction.
A mysterious apex predator is stalking orcas and boats off the coast of Kodiak, Alaska. Sea monster sightings, first studied by Sanderson before his death, have spiked in that area recently.
Phil and Jess search whitewater rapids and a frigid Alaskan lake for a legendary beast that's now the target of serious scientific enquiry.
Ed Stafford tests his body's ultimate limits as he races against medic and ultra-marathon runner Sun Lingye across the arduous mountain terrains of Taiwan.
Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock are joined by special guests Alex Jones, Alex Brooker, Sarah Millican, and James Acaster.

Jimmy Carr hosts, as team captain Sean Lock and Kevin Bridges are up against Jon Richardson and Kathy Burke, with Joe Lycett in Dictionary Corner, while Nick Helm 'helps' Rachel Riley with the numbers and letters.
Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock are joined by Mel Giedroyc, Johnny Vegas, Kym Marsh and Aisling Bea in this edition.
Rick tries to discipline the kids.

Joker Kyle has just three weeks and £12,000 to pull off the perfect wedding for his bride-to-be, Kate. Kate dreams of a traditional affair that is all about her, with a perfect dress to match, but Kyle wants his wedding day to go with a proper bang.

Magician Jack has just three weeks and £12,000 to pull off the perfect wedding for Sarah. Jack wants to put on his biggest magic show ever for his wedding day, while all Sarah wants is one day in her life when she can be the centre of attention.
First Jon renovates the family's home for a successful sale, while Drew hunts down the best options for the family's next property and oversees the selling and buying.
With three growing kids, Missy and Jay are looking for a sprawling forever home; Jonathan comes up with a plan to update the interiors and significantly increase the home's sale price.
High-flyers Bob and Louise, ditzy Will and Kim, and Iranian expats Pasha and Haleh compete in Cheltenham, in a week featuring massive portions, a tale of heroism and Persian rice pudding.
In Gloucestershire, Debbie and Paul, Angela and John, and Kirsty and James compete in a week featuring a malfunctioning blender, a singing dog and plenty of catty comments.
Gill and Mark, Matt and Derek, and Cat and Martin compete to host the best dinner party in Glasgow, in a week featuring an impromptu sing-song, a kitchen disaster and an MC battle.
Three couples compete to host the best dinner party in Essex, in a week featuring deep-fried jam sandwiches and some attention-grabbing burlesque.

The co-founders of College HUNKS Hauling Junk & Moving go on separate missions to make certain that the foundation of their company is strong enough to withstand exponential growth in the next couple of years.
Gordon's in Redondo Beach, California, to visit Zayna Flaming Grill, a Mediterranean restaurant owned and run by aunt and niece duo Faye and Brenda.
Gordon Ramsay is back in Redondo Beach, California, for the conclusion of his challenge to save Zayna Flaming Grill from imploding, and he still faces more questions than answers.
Gordon Ramsay is in Easton, Pennsylvania, to visit struggling Italian restaurant Bella Luna. Rosaria bought the establishment to realise her son Gianfranco's ambition to become a chef.
To see if they've heeded his advice, Chef Ramsay checks up on La Galleria, the Olde Hitching Post and Prohibition Grille.

Gordon Ramsay travels in the USA, aiming to fix hopeless hotels, mediocre motels and bed & breakfasts with bad standards. In the first programme, Gordon visits Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, to try to rescue the failing Roosevelt Inn. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Roosevelt's owner, John Hough, is more interested in telling jokes and dressing up as Sherlock Holmes than he is in fixing his struggling B&B.

It's a nightmare Christmas when Father Ted and Father Dougal get lost in a department store's vast lingerie department - only Ted's quick thinking can save the church from another embarrassing scandal.
Award-winning comedian Sarah Millican performs to her home crowd at the Newcastle Tyne Theatre, talking about settling down, the need to put down some roots now that she has cats, and even a tree.

Jimmy Carr hosts, with team captain Sean Lock and Rhod Gilbert up against rival captain Jon Richardson and Sara Pascoe. Johnny Vegas is in Dictionary Corner, while Joey Essex 'assists' Rachel Riley with the numbers and letters.

What did the armchair critics make of 'Adolescence', 'Tribe with Bruce Parry', and 'Bad Dog Academy?' Also, 'Tempting Fortune', 'The Yorkshire Vet', 'Million Dollar Secret' and 'ITV News (Greenland/Wrestling)'.

With the season of love arriving, Fred and the team welcome a batch of hopeful singletons all looking for 'the one', including Mayfair-based jewellery designer Miki, hapless city worker Arnie and self-confessed nerd Sam.

Fred and his team welcome more hopeful singletons from all over the country, including sassy choir master Jay, investment banker Robbie and property manager by day, glamorous burlesque dancer by night, Becky.

This time on the 'Box: 'Adolescence', '99 to Beat', 'Britain's Got Talent', 'David Blaine: Do Not Attempt', 'Big Night of Musicals by The National Lottery', 'Coronation Street' and 'Building Britain's Superhomes'.
Sonny is a party fanatic. His bride Jasmine is unsure about his plans for a zoo-themed Ibizan beach party with body paint.

Warren tries his best to support Mercedes, but his scorned ex-girlfriend is never far away. Guilt consumes one resident. Frankie opens up about her past. Sienna, Dodger and the McQueens step in to help new mum Cleo finally get the support she needs.
Will Andy's plans for a skater-themed wedding make his bride Bobby's wheels spin? Or will there be broken bones as well as hearts on the big day?
A teacher's grandmother dies, and she inherits her grandmother's cute but mischievous pug. The dog is only small but has the ability to have a big impact and turn the teacher's life upside down.

Gordon heads to Norwalk, Ohio, in America's farming heartland, for the first of two visits to the Mill Street Bistro. There he encounters Joe Nagy, one of the most pretentious restaurant owners he has ever met.
In the dramatic conclusion to the Mill Street Bistro saga, Gordon's disagreement with proprietor Joe Nagy erupts into one of his most intense confrontations yet.
The finalists make citrus celebration cakes, crème brûlée doughnuts and a tribute to iconic British landscapes. Who'll be the zest and be crowned the series winner?
A quick-witted eight-year-old makes life miserable for four high-tech spies trying to recover a top-secret computer chip.

Bart's special April Fools' Day prank seriously misfires when the whole house explodes. Homer ends up in the hospital where a candy machine falls on top of him, sending him into a coma. While clips are shown of past blows to his head, family and visitors debate what to do about Homer.

At his high-school reunion, Homer wins several awards including 'Most Weight Gained' and 'Most Improved Odour', but the Principal takes them away when he finds out that Homer never graduated. Homer vows to graduate and win them back by going to night school.

The Springfield holiday of Whacking Day is coming, when live snakes get whacked with sticks, and Homer can hardly wait, but Lisa is horrified and persuades Barry White to help by attracting the snakes to safety.

When Krusty the Klown's network show gets cancelled, Bart and Lisa unite to get him back on TV by enlisting some of Krusty's celebrity friends to appear on a comeback special. On the guest list are Bette Midler, Hugh Hefner, the Red Hot Chili Peppers, Elizabeth Taylor, Johnny Carson and Luke Perry. After the show the celebrities head for Moe's to hang out together.
Homer reminisces about the Be Sharps, the barbershop quartet he was in with Barney, Apu and Principal Skinner.

Homer invests all the family's money in a company that makes "Animotion" machines. After the company declares bankruptcy, Homer becomes a human guinea pig to raise some cash. The scientists find a crayon lodged in his brain and when it is removed, he suddenly becomes extremely intelligent.

When Homer ends up in the prison infirmary after visiting the prison rodeo, Marge notices the artistic talent of jailbird Jack Crowley and vouches for him at his parole hearing. However, when she gets him a job painting a mural at the school, he clashes artistically with Principal Skinner. Meanwhile, Homer sets up a chiropractor business with the help of an old dustbin, aka the Spine-O-Cylinder.

Paul, Prue, Matt and Noel celebrate New Year 2022 with Kim-Joy and Jon from Bake Off 2018 and Hermine and Rowan from the 2020 Bake Off bubble. They compete over three seasonal challenges to see who will win the first Star Baker crown of 2022.
Brittany and Ben, who are hoping for a straightforward birth, get ready for an induction. Clementine and Olumide prepare to welcome their second baby together.
Five assassins find themselves on a fast moving bullet train from Tokyo to Morioka with only a few stops in between. They discover their missions are not unrelated to each other.
Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching: 'Jamie's Air Fryer Meals', 'Baby Reindeer', 'Teen First Dates', 'The Circle', 'Wildlife Rescue', 'Expedition X', and ITV News (Dogfather).
Aktuelle Skilanglauf Wettbewerbe, die durch den internationalen Skiverband FIS ausgerichtet werden.
Aktuell liegt eine Sendepause vor und alle Übertragungen sind vorübergehend eingestellt.
Übertragungen von internationalen FIS Ski Alpin Weltcup Rennen.
Übertragungen von FIS Nordische Kombinations Wettkämpfen der Frauen und Männer.
In diversen Beiträgen und Zusammenfassungen wird über Stars und Events der Sportbranche berichtet.
Die Übertragung der aktuellen Wettkämpfe des IBU Biathlon Weltcups.
Übertragung von aktuellen Skispringen and Skiflug Wettbewerben im FIS Weltcup.
Die Übertragung der World Snooker Tour.
Mother Angelica and the Nuns of Our Lady of the Angels Monastery pray the chaplet of St Michael to honour the greatest warrior of the heavens.
Journalist Colm Flynn sits down with Father Mitch Pacwa, Dr Stefana Dan Laing, and producer Leo Severino to discuss how `Zero AD: The Birth of Christ' was crafted for the big screen.
Teaching and preaching the word of God.
Uncovers hidden gems of faith that have preserved our heritage, celebrated our devotions and inspired people across the United States.
Fr Krause concentrates on the mission and task that Jesus gave us, to break beyond selfish isolation and share a richer life in communion with God and all the Saints.
Scott Hahn and Mike Aquilina explain that at each Mass we renew our Covenant with God, which has been sealed in the Blood of Christ.
Father Mitch Pacwa talks about the Levites and judges in the discussion on the Old Testament.
St Francis of Assisi as an example of the religious movements renewing the Church.

Fr Mitch Pacwa leads the Joyful Mysteries of the Rosary from the actual holy sites and shrines where they took place, bringing the Gospels to life and offering a deeper understanding of the rosary meditations.
The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word give the litany of the Divine Child Jesus at the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament located in Hanceville, Alabama.
Father Apostoli talks about the intensified situation in which Jesus finds himself: performing miraculous cures but being met with stern political resistance and opposition.
The Louisville Chorus sings songs of joy and exaltation.
The Carlow Choir performs at St Francis Xavier Cathedral.
Japan as seen in 1549, when St Francis Xavier arrived to begin his work of evangelization.
Friedrich Nietzsche and Edith Stein's debate continues, culminating in a breaking point that leads St Teresa Benedicta of the Cross to proclaim that all need to make sacrifices and pray for sinners.
A televised format of Dr. David Anders' popular and engaging radio show that asks atheists, former Catholics and non-Catholics: What is stopping you from becoming Catholic?

The entire family will enjoy Mother's world-famous witty wisdom. From the hilarious to the miraculous to the purely poignant, we have compiled your all-time favourites to inspire, educate, and entertain you all over again.
Bob and Penny Lord examine the life of St. Catherine of Bologna, an Italian Poor Clare nun known as a writer, teacher, artist and mystic.
Jennifer Hubbard shares her journey to forgiveness regarding her daughter's being one of the victims of a mass shooting at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut.

Presenting the latest news from the Vatican with excerpts and analysis of the Holy Father's recent audiences and writings, newsmaker interviews, highlights of recent events, and feature segments — all from the heart of the Universal Church. We journey through Italy's mountains and valleys, discovering hidden sanctuaries and tracing the country's deep roots of faith.
Live from Knock, Ireland, celebrate Mass from the pilgrimage site and national shrine known worldwide for the miraculous apparitions in 1879.
The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word celebrate the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass.
The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word pray the Litany of the Sacred Heart at the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Alabama.
Fr Connor shares the motives for faith and its benefits, as well as the formulations of faith in creeds of the Church.
An outlook at The Chaplet of Divine Mercy prayer, from the chapel of the National Shrine of the Divine Mercy in Stockbridge, Massachusetts.
Priests and pledges perform a live adoration from Our Lady of the Angels Chapel in Irondale, Alabama.
Mother quotes scriptural passages on living in union with God. John notes that the disciples' reward depends on abiding in God and loving one another.

The Fathers answer emails concerning falling asleep during prayer, why Moses didn't enter the Promised Land, why people are Confirmed, when we ask God to forgive our sins, and what to do about an unfaithful friend.

Edmund Adamus discusses 'A Fertile Heart', the faith-inspired programme that aids young people, through relationship-building and sexual health education, to shape their future and discover the truth about themselves.
Advent is the season of preparation, and Maranatha signals the coming of our Lord at Christmas. Get ready to receive Him by turning away from sin and proactively pursuing good deeds.
Pilgrims gather together, learn the joyful mystery and pray with the rosary at the Massabielle Grotto in Lourdes, France.
Saint Edmund Campion, a Jesuit in the 16th century, faces many challenges as he becomes involved with English royalty.
Join the Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word as they celebrate Vespers and Benediction of the Blessed Sacrament from Our Lady of the Angels Chapel in Irondale, Alabama.

Experience some of the most inspirational interviews and discussions Fr Benedict Groeschel had throughout his ministry. Fr Groeschel fills hearts with hope as he reveals one statement that will help people escape their own prison.

Harlem drug dealer Frank Lucas rises to power in corrupt 1970s New York, equalling and surpassing the notorious Mafia families with the reach of his empire. On the other side of the law, honest cop Richie Roberts dedicates himself to taking down `the most dangerous man walking the streets'. Lucas acts with impunity, smuggling heroin into the US in the coffins of American soldiers killed in Vietnam.

On a night-time motorway journey, young couple Zakes and Beth catch a horrifying glimpse of a young woman imprisoned in the back of a truck. When the two stop at a service station, Beth goes missing and a terrified Zakes races to track her down, fearing she has become the driver's next victim.

A lone rider arrives in a small town and meets a young boy who, while awaiting trial for the murder of the local bully, fears he may be killed by his victim's family. As he becomes involved in the morass of shifting partnerships that dominate the community, the rider vows to fight against the three corrupt brothers who are intent on taking the law into their own violent hands.

Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.
Movie, Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy, Drama

Shunned by the relentlessly happy citizens of Whoville, the Grinch retreats to his gloomy lair on Mt Crumpit. Come December, the only one smiling is the Grinch, who's stolen everyone's presents. However, a little girl sees some good in the furry grouch, so there may be a merry Christmas after all.

Left behind when his family goes away for Christmas holiday, Kevin McCallister enjoys unprecedented freedom of the house and the possessions of his siblings. Using an array of homemade weaponry, he manages to fend off a pair of dim-witted burglars.

A boy is once again accidentally separated from his parents after an airport mix-up sees him lost and alone in New York. Coincidentally, two familiar villains are also in town plotting their finest crime to date.
Wrongfully accused of trying to kill the president, a framed Secret Service agent must evade the FBI and his own agency to uncover the truth and save the country from imminent danger.

On the run from a lethal assassin, a wily con artist devises a scheme to hide out inside a small-town police station. However, when the hitman turns up at the precinct, an unsuspecting rookie cop finds herself caught in the crosshairs.

Thanksgiving means food and football, so Jesse Palmer challenges the bakers to create holiday 7-layer desserts inspired by his favourite snack. The bakers compete in a Thanksgiving pie-off to win over judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Nancy Fuller.
Five skilled amateur gingerbread artists take edible architecture to new heights as they go head-to-head at the 25th Annual National Gingerbread House Competition in Asheville, North Carolina.

In this live-action adaptation of the beloved children's tale by Dr. Seuss, the reclusive green Grinch (Jim Carrey) decides to ruin Christmas for the cheery citizens of Whoville. Reluctantly joined by his hapless dog, Max, the Grinch comes down from his mountaintop home and sneaks into town to swipe everything holiday-related from the Whos. However, the bitter grump finds a hitch in his plans when he encounters the endearing Cindy Lou Who (Taylor Momsen).

Monsters Incorporated is the largest scare factory in the monster world, and James P. Sullivan (John Goodman) is one of its top scarers. Sullivan is a huge, intimidating monster with blue fur, large purple spots and horns. His scare assistant, best friend and roommate is Mike Wazowski (Billy Crystal), a green, opinionated, feisty little one-eyed monster. Visiting from the human world is Boo (Mary Gibbs), a tiny girl who goes where no human has ever gone before.

Ever since he was a kid monster, Mike Wazowski (Billy Crystal) has dreamed of becoming a Scarer. To make his dream a reality, he enrolls at Monsters University. During his first semester, he meets Sulley (John Goodman), a natural-born Scarer. Sulley and Mike engage in a fierce rivalry that ultimately gets them both kicked out of MU's elite Scare Program. To make things right, Mike and Sulley -- along with a bunch of misfit monsters -- will have to learn to work together.

A young circus elephant is born with comically large ears and given the cruel nickname Dumbo. One day at a show, he is taunted by a group of kids, inciting his mother into a rage that gets her locked up. After Dumbo's ears cause an accident that injures many of the other elephants, he is made to dress like a clown and perform dangerous stunts. Everything changes when Dumbo discovers that his enormous ears actually allow him to fly, and he astounds everyone at the circus with his new talent.

Kenai is a young Indian brave with a particular distaste for bears. When his brother Sitka is killed by one, Kenai in turn kills the bear, only to be magically transformed into one himself. To make matters worse, his other brother Denahi vows to kill the bear Kenai has become. Kenai's only hope is a magical mountain where he believes he can be changed back to a human, and he enlists a real bear cub, Koda, to get him there.

Twenty-thousand years ago, Earth was a wondrous, prehistoric world filled with great danger, not the least of which is the beginning of the Ice Age. To avoid a terrible frostbite, the planet's majestic creatures - and a few small, slothful ones - start migrating south. The story revolves around sub-zero heroes: a woolly mammoth, a saber-toothed tiger, a sloth and a prehistoric combination of a squirrel and rat, known as Scrat.

With global warming threatening their once-icy domain with widespread flooding, Manny (Ray Romano), Sid (John Leguizamo) and Diego (Denis Leary) set out to find a safe haven. Along the way, another mammoth (Queen Latifah), who thinks she is an opossum, joins the travelers on their perilous quest.

Flik is an inventive ant who's always messing things up for his colony. His latest mishap was destroying the food stores that were supposed to be used to pay off grasshopper Hopper. Now the strong-arming insect is demanding that the ants gather double the food or face annihilation. To avert disaster, Flik goes on a journey to recruit fighters to defend the colony. When he meets a band of high-flying circus insects, he thinks he's found his salvation.

In this lauded Pixar animated film, married superheroes Mr. Incredible (Craig T. Nelson) and Elastigirl (Holly Hunter) are forced to assume mundane lives as Bob and Helen Parr after all super-powered activities have been banned by the government. While Mr. Incredible loves his wife and kids, he longs to return to a life of adventure, and he gets a chance when summoned to an island to battle an out-of-control robot. Soon, Mr. Incredible is in trouble, and it's up to his family to save him.

A design show host finds a letter from Santa promising to meet her true love, a man named Nick, by Christmas Eve. Meeting three Nicks complicates her search.

Single dad Taylor is inspired more than ever to give his two children the best Christmas in their new town. He leads the city's holiday event department, as new colleague Sophie supervises him.
Nell's last stop on a nationwide book tour takes her to Springdale, the hometown of Emmett, a young man she met while both were junior copy editors at a New York publishing company.
Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge, and the two find a connection as well.

A former television star waits out a scandal in Vermont. She becomes close with the innkeeper and his daughter while she helps him direct the local Christmas pageant.
This Hanukkah, a magical menorah shows Hannah that love has always been right in front of her in the form of her childhood best friend Ethan -- if only she's willing to take the risk.

While the Earp brothers may have won the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, they didn't escape unscathed for long. Seeking revenge over their fallen comrades, members of the Clanton gang go after the Earp family, gunning down both Virgil and Morgan Earp. But they don't succeed at getting Wyatt. Now it's his turn to seek revenge. With Doc Holliday by his side, Wyatt forms a posse, and they won't rest until every member of the Clanton gang is dead.

In this Christmas classic, an old man going by the name of Kris Kringle (Edmund Gwenn) fills in for an intoxicated Santa in Macy's annual Thanksgiving Day parade. Kringle proves to be such a hit that he is soon appearing regularly at the chain's main store in midtown Manhattan. When Kringle surprises customers and employees alike by claiming that he really is Santa Claus, it leads to a court case to determine his mental health and, more importantly, his authenticity.

Poppy (Cary Grant) and Anna Rose (Betsy Drake) have a soft spot for young people in need. Despite having three children of their own, they can't help but take action when they meet a pair of troubled young orphans. Young Jane (Iris Mann) is horribly depressed, while Jimmy (Clifford Tatum Jr.) is physically disabled and has a long history as a troublemaker. As they welcome the pair into their home, the Roses use love and understanding to help the orphans get to the bottom of their problems.

Alvarez Kelly (William Holden) is a Mexican cattle rancher who is doing his best to stay out of the Civil War. He has no interest in which side may win or lose -- Kelly is far more concerned about his own survival, and about making money. He soon finds himself in the middle of the conflict, however, when a confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) captures the rancher and forces Kelly to help his soldiers steal a nearby herd of cattle, which they desperately need for food.
A wanted gunman is known by the way he draws.

Montana rancher Cyrus Higbee (Don Beddoe) asks his foreman, Gene Autry (Gene Autry), to travel with Rawhide Buttram (Pat Buttram) to Higbee Lodge in Canada, where he suspects his daughter, Sandy (Gail Davis), is disregarding his orders by starting a dude ranch and disrupting the logging industry. Higbee also regards Sandy's fiancé, Todd (Ross Ford), as insincere. When they arrive, Gene and Rawhide are set upon by vengeful mill workers and Sandy's mysterious foreman, Pop Phillips (Tom London).

Together, their showy tricks and charisma command large crowds and tip payments -- until Flanagan and the cynical Coughlin have a falling out. Flanagan moves to Jamaica to raise enough money to open his own bar, where he falls in love with artist Jordan Mooney (Elisabeth Shue).

Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper.

Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway.

Six years after a group of high-school students first cheated death, another teen (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) has a premonition that she and her friends will be involved in a horrifying roller-coaster accident. When the vision proves true, the student and her fellow survivors must deal with the repercussions of cheating the Grim Reaper.

During a bus ride with his colleagues to a corporate retreat, Sam (Nicholas D'Agosto) experiences a horrifying vision: the suspension bridge that they -- and many others -- are crossing starts to crumble around them. When his vision ends and, almost immediately, starts to come true, Sam takes quick action that saves a number of people, including his girlfriend, Molly (Emma Bell), and his best friend, Peter (Miles Fisher). However, the survivors soon find that Death will not be denied.

Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

Nerdy college student Columbus (Jesse Eisenberg) has survived the plague that has turned mankind into flesh-devouring zombies because he's scared of just about everything. Gun-toting, Twinkie-loving Tallahassee (Woody Harrelson) has no fears. Together, they are about to stare down their most horrifying challenge yet: each other's company. Emma Stone and Abigail Breslin co-star in this double-hitting, head-smashing comedy.
Movie, Horror, Comedy, Drama, Action, Adventure

Rachel acompaña a Nick, su novio, a una boda en Singapur. En Asia, Rachel queda atónita cuando descubre que Nick es el heredero de una familia inmensamente rica, todas las jóvenes locales se lo quieren arrebatar y su madre desaprueba su relación.

Una familia decide mudarse al campo para comenzar de nuevo tras ser obligada a dejar su vida. Sin embargo, sus tres hijos descubren un árbol mágico que los transportará a un mundo de fantasía habitado por extraordinarios personajes. Toda la familia encontrará una oportunidad para reconectarse y redescubrir lo que realmente importa.

Oobah se propone sacudir el mundo del vino al reenvasar un vino de mala calidad contaminado por humo, utilizado para elaborar salsa barbacoa y desinfectante de manos, y venderlo como un producto prémium de 500 dólares la botella. Para convencer a un distribuidor de comercializarlo, inventa una convincente historia sobre su origen, intenta convertirse en un maestro sommelier por métodos poco convencionales y engaña a destacados críticos de vino para obtener su respaldo.
Tras la fachada de una vida familiar aparentemente perfecta, se avecina una tormenta.
Artistas y líderes latinos ofrecen testimonios personales.

Heridas enterradas desde hace mucho tiempo salen a la superficie cuando la icónica estrella del pop Mother Mary se reencuentra con su mejor amiga, de quien se había distanciado, y su antigua diseñadora de vestuario, en vísperas de su concierto de regreso.

Separadas y decepcionadas con la vida adulta, las Bellas se reúnen de nuevo y están listas para dar la nota, y meter la pata, en una competición europea donde descubren que deberán usar mucho más que sus voces para vencer a sus rivales.

Un asesinato que ocurrió en una escuela de Baltimore en 1983 causó el encarcelamiento injusto de tres adolescentes durante 36 años. Ta-Nehisi Coates investiga cómo este caso afecta a los acusados, a los testigos y a su comunidad.
La historia de cómo unos desconocidos encuentran refugio en un McDonald's durante una tormenta en Buffalo.

Durante el estreno de Doméstica, Carla expone el comportamiento abusivo de Leo. Mientras Charo lidia con las implicaciones morales de realizar la docuserie, Patricia decide someterse a un tratamiento experimental financiado con el dinero de su indemnización. Luego, tras perder el contacto con la realidad, Raquel termina en Núcleo, con consecuencias trágicas.
Jackie y Nina, dos grandes amigas de San Antonio (Texas), combinan su fiesta de quinceañera con la escaramuza, un baile tradicional mexicano.
Ashley, una boxeadora amateur que vive en Los Ángeles, está nerviosa por su primera pelea cuando se acerca su fiesta de quinceañera.
Rosi decide celebrar su fiesta de quinceañera en La Habana después de que es negada la visa a su abuelo.
Zoey, transexual estadounidense de origen mexicano, celebra que cumple 15 años.
Una joven se ve envuelta en el gran conflicto entre la riqueza tradicional y la nueva riqueza en la alta sociedad neoyorquina de finales del siglo XIX.
Bertha regresa a un hogar en el que reina la frialdad. Las aspiraciones profesionales de Peggy entran en conflicto con la gente de Newport. Agnes concede una entrevista a regañadientes.
La familia Russell se enfrenta a las consecuencias de las acciones de Bertha, mientras que George se ve sometido a una presión enorme por el futuro de su empresa.

New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region.
Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home.

From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race.
Movie, Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror

Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller.

Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm begins to wreak havoc outside.

College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime.
A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).

Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor.

Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.
In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown.
Movie, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller

When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun.
An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak.
A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer.

After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe.

Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown.

In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart.
Movie, Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction

In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever.

Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests.

Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans.
Movie, Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy

Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission.
Movie, Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action, Crime drama, Fantasy, Science fiction

Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter finds a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem.

Previously thought to be extinct, a massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific. With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon.
Movie, Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror

Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before.

A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home.
A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter.

After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated.

Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon finds the music that's always been inside him.

It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya.

Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth.

Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish.

Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet.

Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims.

Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run.

Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, attempts to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money.

Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

In the wake of her death, the embittered children of Chinese-American matriarch Mrs. Xiao (Lisa Lu) begrudgingly return to their childhood home for a bristly -- and brief, they hope -- reunion. But after Xiao's maid and sole confidant, Viola (Talia Shire), reveals her wish to undergo a week-long Buddhist funeral rite, the younger Xiaos -- including plastic surgeon Alexander (Russell Wong) and lesbian actress Meimei (Steph Song) -- have seven days to come to terms with her death, and each other.

This sweeping account of the life of Pu Yi (John Lone), the last emperor of China, follows the leader's tumultuous reign. After being captured by the Red Army as a war criminal in 1950, Pu Yi recalls his childhood from prison. He remembers his lavish youth in the Forbidden City, where he was afforded every luxury but unfortunately sheltered from the outside world and complex political situation surrounding him. As revolution sweeps through China, the world Pu Yi knew is dramatically upended.

"The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors.

When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past.

When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society starts to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia.

The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody.
Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason.
Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963.

Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises.

As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and maybe vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain.

Directed by Al Reinert and with music scored by Brian Eno, "For All Mankind" provides a testament to NASA's Apollo program of the 1960s and '70s. Composed of actual NASA footage of the missions and astronaut interviews, the documentary offers the viewpoint of the individuals who braved the remarkable journey to the moon and back. While compiling the material for the film, Reinert went through more than six million feet of film of these historic moments.

Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them.

Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion.
John McClane viaja a Rusia en busca de su hijo y descubre que es un agente de la CIA con una misión. Ambos deben superar sus diferencias para proteger a un testigo y evitar una catástrofe.

La joven Furiosa es arrebatada del Paraje Verde de las Muchas Madres por una horda de motociclistas. El señor de la guerra que dirige su grupo se enfrenta a otro tirano y, mientras tanto, Furiosa aprovecha la batalla para intentar volver a casa.

Un grupo de ex soldados y un biólogo se enfrentarán a los cazadores más letales de todo el universo, quienes han alterado sus cuerpos con el ADN de otras especies para hacer desaparecer a la raza humana.
Movie, Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror
Una pareja adicta al trabajo decide tomarse unas vacaciones buceando en las Bahamas. Sin embargo, la lancha que los lleva al medio de la mar los abandona en unas aguas infestadas de tiburones.

Mary es una psicóloga infantil que vive en un área rural y aislada con su hijastro catatónico, el cual quedó así en un accidente de circulación en el que murió su esposo. Lo lúgubre de su entorno toma un cariz macabro cuando se convence de que el fantasma de un niño, antiguo paciente suyo, ha penetrado en su vivienda para atormentarlos.

Faith, Brit, Cotty y Candy son cuatro jóvenes estudiantes dispuestas a llegar al extremo con tal de conseguir dinero para emprender lo que se presenta como el viaje de sus vidas durante las vacaciones de primavera.

Un hombre que lava dinero para la mafia rusa pide a una pareja inglesa que está de vacaciones en Marruecos que entregue información a un agente del MI6, el servicio secreto británico. Asegura que va a delatar a muchos criminales para los que trabaja a cambio de asilo político en el Reino Unido.
Al mudarse de Montana, un joven y sus amigos en Florida enfrentan a políticos y urbanizadores por la protección de búhos en extinción.
El reconocido bailarín Pierre Dulaine acepta un trabajo en una escuela pública de Nueva York y ayuda a sus estudiantes a combinar el estilo hip-hop de ellos con su estilo clásico.

Adelaida y su esposo viajan a la casa en la que ella creció junto a la playa. Tiene un presentimiento siniestro que precede a un encuentro espeluznante: cuatro enmascarados se presentan ante su casa. Lo aterrador viene cuando muestran sus rostros.

En 1960, siete adolescentes lucharon contra un malvado demonio que asesinaba niños oculto tras la máscara de un payaso. Treinta años después, el demonio regresa a la ciudad y los amigos deciden reunirse para detenerlo de una vez por todas.
Movie, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mystery, Thriller

Una monja se suicida en una abadía rumana y el Vaticano envía a un sacerdote y una novicia a investigar lo sucedido. Lo que ambos encuentran allá es un secreto perverso que los enfrentará cara a cara con el mal en su esencia más pura.
Francia, 1956. El asesinato de un sacerdote provoca que un mal demoníaco se extienda sin control. La hermana Irene deberá enfrentarse, de nuevo, a la monja satánica Valak.

Cuando encuentra a la tercera víctima de un asesino en serie que no deja ninguna pista, el agente del FBI Joe Merriweather decide pedir ayuda a su amigo, el doctor Clancy, cuyas visiones pueden ayudarlo a resolver el caso.
The journey of pop star Michael Jackson, from his early days to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuels a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.
Movie, Biography, Drama, Music, Pop, Soul, R&B, Funk, Rock
Friends and enemies alike attend annual Twelfth Night Festivities, with murderous results; Julia attempts a desperate escape.

Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

With bodies piling up and a citywide gala underway, Hondo and the Exiles make their final move against the inside conspiracy hunting S.W.A.T.; Hondo has to decide exactly what kind of leader he's willing to become to protect the team he built.
The singer-songwriter performs a repertoire of her festive holiday hits, including the chart-topping perennial favorite "All I Want for Christmas Is You."

After petty criminal Johnny (Damon Wayans) falls for the lovely Amber (Stacey Dash), he decides to stop breaking the law and gets a gig at his crush's workplace in order to get closer to her, thus proving that he's a stand-up guy. Soon, he learns that going straight doesn't pay very well, so he decides to nab a company credit card and show off his newfound wealth to Amber. Unfortunately, a blackmailer catches Johnny and forces him to commit a crime that is far from small.

Legendary soul musician Ray Charles is portrayed by Jamie Foxx in this Oscar-winning biopic. Young Ray watches his 7-year-old brother drown at age seven. When he loses his sight at the age of 9, his hardworking mother (Sharon Warren) urges him not to feel sorry for himself. He rises through the ranks of the Seattle jazz scene, struggling with drug addiction and infidelity while on the road. Supported by his wife (Kerry Washington), Ray Charles redefines soul music and inspires a generation.
Movie, Biography, Historical drama, Music, R&B, Soul, Blues, Gospel, Country, Jazz, Pop, Rock

At holiday time, family matriarch Ma'Dere Whitfield (Loretta Devine) assembles her large brood for their first reunion in four years. However, family ties show signs of strain when various secrets come to light, especially concerning Marine Claude's (Columbus Short) true military status, Quentin's (Idris Elba) debts and teenage Baby's (Chris Brown) secret plans to become a singer.

Hondo Harrelson gets one shot at redemption: build an S.W.A.T. unit from LA's overlooked talent; the team clicks under fire, but one of Hondo's own made a promise that has nothing to do with protecting S.W.A.T.

When the Exiles descend on a family business, a father-son power struggle boils over into a hostage standoff with deeper roots than turf; taking point as Scout for the first time, Malik faces an impossible call: one that will haunt him and the squad.

A manhunt pushes the Exiles to their breaking point; when a decision Hondo made to shield his squad from scrutiny comes back to bite him, he realizes someone close to him may know more than they're letting on.

Called to account for a mission gone sideways, Hondo and the Exiles are forced to relive a hostage rescue disguised as an ICE raid; as the board digs for answers, Hondo uncovers footage that changes everything he thought he knew about his own squad.

When a foreign dignitary is targeted in a hit hidden inside a protest scheme, the Exiles race to identify the real threat; as a shocking murder causes chaos, Malik's growing web of secrets puts him on a collision course with the rest of the team.

When the FBI comes calling, Jude is pulled back undercover to infiltrate a white supremacist crew he spent years with; as his true history comes to light, the Exiles must reckon with what he did to survive and whether they can still trust him.

In Steven Spielberg's massive blockbuster, paleontologists Alan Grant (Sam Neill) and Ellie Sattler (Laura Dern) and mathematician Ian Malcolm (Jeff Goldblum) are among a select group chosen to tour an island theme park populated by dinosaurs created from prehistoric DNA. While the park's mastermind, billionaire John Hammond (Richard Attenborough), assures everyone that the facility is safe, they find out otherwise when various ferocious predators break free and go on the hunt.
Movie, Adventure, Action, Science fiction, Thriller
Four years after "Jurassic Park," mathematician Ian Malcolm ventures onto a second island to save his girlfriend from becoming dinosaur bait.
Movie, Adventure, Action, Science fiction, Thriller

After being persuaded by a wealthy businessman to conduct an aerial tour of Isla Sorna, InGen's second site for a failed Jurassic Park experiment, Dr. Alan Grant discovers the true reason for his invitation. A tragic accident maroons the party of seven, and they must attempt to escape with their lives.
Movie, Adventure, Action, Science fiction, Thriller
Rafi, Hank and Goliath, a trio of talking turtles, are living the good life at a Florida animal park. But when vandals kidnap Hank, it's up to Rafi and Goliath to find their missing friend.
A brother and sister befriend a badly sunburned dolphin that has been separated from its family, uncovering a secret plan that could destroy the beach and their new friend's home.
The kids are thrilled that Bernie has come back. But so has their old enemy Winston, who's about to kidnap the talented dolphin. Kevin and Holly must rescue their splashy friend before it's too late.
A young vegetarian lion is shunned by other carnivores.
A New York teen (Aimee Teegarden) discovers a family secret while spending the summer in California with her estranged grandmother (Patricia Richardson).

A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

After the success of the song "I Can Only Imagine," MercyMe's Bart Millard has it all until fame begins to cost him what matters most. When hopeful newcomer Tim Timmons joins the band for their biggest tour yet, he unknowingly brings a renewed gratitude to Bart's life.
Dumped by his girlfriend, a young physics genius travels back in time to change the past and win her heart again.

For the past 60 years, a wisecracking alien named Paul (Seth Rogen) has resided at a top-secret military base in America's UFO heartland. When Paul decides he has had enough of Earth, he escapes from the compound and hops on the first handy vehicle -- a rented RV manned by two British sci-fi nerds named Graeme (Simon Pegg) and Clive (Nick Frost). With federal agents and the father of an accidental kidnap victim on their tail, the two hatch a crazy plan to help Paul return to his spaceship.

Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them.

Ever since her father drilled into her head that monogamy isn't realistic, magazine writer Amy has made promiscuity her credo. As much as she enjoys an uninhibited life free of commitment, Amy is really in a rut. While writing a profile about charming and successful sports doctor Aaron Conners, she finds herself actually falling in love for the first time, and what's more, Aaron seems to like her too. Amy starts to wonder if it's time to clean up her act.
A jilted man (Brandon Routh) shares his apartment with a seemingly ideal couple (Jesse Bradford, Sophia Bush) who intrude on his life.

As a former London constable, Nicholas Angel (Simon Pegg) finds it difficult to adapt to his new assignment in the sleepy British village of Sandford. Not only does he miss the excitement of the big city, but he also has a well-meaning oaf (Nick Frost) for a partner. However, when a series of grisly accidents rocks Sandford, Nick smells something rotten in the idyllic village.

A former cop turned private investigator gets hired to find a missing R&B star. His investigation uncovers a connection to a larger conspiracy, forcing him to question those around him and his own past.
Three dysfunctional co-workers embark on a mission to help their newfound friend lose his sexual innocence.
A young woman (Britt Robertson) chronicles her sexual adventures in an anonymous blog that exposes her innermost desires, shames and secrets.

Crunch Calhoun, a motorcycle daredevil and art thief, agrees to help his brother with one last heist. As Crunch gathers his old team and plans to steal a priceless book, he has no idea his brother has his own hidden agenda.

For the last 10 years, lifelong buddies Ethan (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), Isaac (Seth Rogen) and Chris (Anthony Mackie) have gathered on Christmas Eve to celebrate the holidays with a bang. As Isaac prepares to become a first-time father, the friends realize that their annual tradition is coming to a sad end. To make it as memorable as possible, they plan a night of debauchery and hilarity by searching for the Nutcracka Ball, the Holy Grail of Christmas parties in New York.
A power couple (Jerry O'Connell, Heather Graham) has a surprise pregnancy that throws their lives and careers into a tailspin.

When Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), an art dealer, and Gary (Vince Vaughn), a tour-bus driver, finally call it quits in their relationship, neither is willing to move out of their shared condo. With their friends suggesting a series of underhanded tactics that fail to get either Brooke or Gary to cave in, the only solution is to become hostile roommates.

In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.
Living off the grid while vacationing at a winter resort, married spies Joe and Lara come under fire from members of the old guard who suspect they've joined an elite team of rogue spies.

When a reunion at a creepy mansion turns into a robbery, four friends discover the owners -- ghosts from the 1950s -- have never left. They soon find themselves battling supernatural terrors as the evil spirits plan a demonic sacrifice.

In a dystopian Detroit, grand houses that once housed the wealthy are now homes of the city's most-dangerous criminals. Surrounding the area is a giant wall to keep the rest of Detroit safe. For undercover cop Damien Collier (Paul Walker), every day is a battle against corruption as he struggles to bring his father's killer, Tremaine (RZA), to justice.
